name: Tune In
tagline: One clue. Everyone guesses where it lands.
description: A dial runs between two opposites, like Cold and Hot. Only the psychic sees the secret target; they give a one-line clue, and everyone slides a dial to where they think it lands. The closer, the more points, for you and the psychic. Play solo, in two teams, or together against the dial.
howToPlay: The psychic secretly sees a target on a dial between two opposites.
They give one clue; everyone else slides a dial to where it lands.
The closer your dial, the more points, for you and the psychic.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: Auto plays together at 2 players and solo at 3+; teams needs 4+, co-op allows up to 8

settings.label: Rounds
settings.description: Solo and co-op; auto gives everyone a turn as the psychic (8 with 2 or 9+ players)

settings.label: Points to win
settings.description: Teams: the first team to this many points wins

settings.label: Most turns
settings.description: Teams: the game ends after this many turns, catch-up turns included

settings.label: Clue time
settings.description: Seconds the psychic has to send a clue

settings.label: Dial time
settings.description: Seconds to slide your dial and lock in

settings.label: Call time
settings.description: Teams: seconds for the other team to call left or right

settings.label: Target size
settings.description: How wide the scoring zones are

settings.label: Huddle
settings.description: Teams and co-op: teammates see each other's dials move and argue it out

settings.label: Spicy dials
settings.description: Mix in adult dials (dates, exes, bad behaviour), never explicit

settings.label: Reader
settings.description: Who reads the dial's ends and the clue aloud
